Recorded decisions govern `src/edge/handler.py`. They were written by someone who is not in this session; read them before changing the file, and if this change departs from one, say so and record why.

## Validate requests at the edge (accepted, 2026-05-02) — docs/decisions/2026-05-02-validate-at-the-edge.md
Request validation runs at the edge handler, before any service call.

## Keep cache keys in one module (status not stated, undated) — docs/decisions/cache-keys.md
Every cache key is built by one module.
